name: Grade 9 IIIT Practice: November Week 11 - Testing and Improvement
description: Practice words for Grade 9 third-trimester STEM and cybersecurity work.

words.definition: Rules used to decide if a test succeeds.
words.example: The test criteria required the product to be clear, stable, and easy to explain.

words.definition: A part that does not work well yet.
words.example: The weakness was that the warning icon was too small to notice.

words.definition: Information that shows what happened or supports an idea.
words.example: The evidence included a photo of the test and a note about the result.

words.definition: A change that makes something better.
words.example: The improvement made the label larger and easier to read.

words.definition: Something that makes results less complete or certain.
words.example: One limitation was that only two classmates tested the product.

words.definition: A clear description of how or why something works.
words.example: The explanation connected the design choice to the user problem.
